method.label: Bound by volume and fit four

annotationRationale: The solution combines a universal volume bound with a packing that attains it. Rectangular-prism volume supplies the bound.
sourceMethod: Follows the official construction and volume comparison. Describes the pictured packing in words and expresses the upper bound by comparing five blocks with the box.

review.mathCheck: Five blocks require 20 cubic inches, exceeding the box's 18. Three 1×2×2 blocks fill a 3×2×2 bottom layer; a 2×2×1 block fits above it. Thus the maximum is four, choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, freshly worded adaptation of official solution 6 and its figure. The verbal packing describes the illustrated construction completely; the volume bound applies regardless of block orientation.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed extremal node captures both the universal upper bound and an attaining construction. cnm_p163 supplies the supporting volume calculation.
